determinism.description: The close arithmetic was established twice from independent directions: (a) by the tool's own ConsistentRead paginated table scan plus its independent S3 listing read, and (b) by summing the four windows' RECLASSIFY-WRITE lines.
determinism.method: Window sum: 187 (run 1, laptop ~SC) + 2 (1313Z probe) + 1,323 (RUN3) + 7 (RUN4) + 0 (RUN5) = 1,519. Independently, the UNRESOLVED census over the RUN3 log read 779 hits across 866 lines with a printed denominator, of which 14 were KIMI_TIMEOUT -- so 765 model-stated + 14 transport, and 1,519 + 765 + 14 = 2,291 held BEFORE RUN4 and RUN5 moved 13 of the 14 into landed-or-final.
determinism.expected_landed: the two paths agree at 1,519 landed and 2,291 total
determinism.expected_not_landed: the two paths disagree, or the total misses 2,291
determinism.observed: They agree exactly, at every stage, and the arithmetic closes at 2,291 after each of RUN3, RUN4 and RUN5. 772 = 765 + 6 (RUN4's model-stated refusals) + 1 (RUN5's).
